program.name: Loaded Balance Long
program.subject: Balance & stability
program.blurb: Balance with weights: single-leg lifts one day, carries and offset holds the next.
program.about: Balance under load. One day is single-leg deadlifts, split squats and step-ups with dumbbells, and balance holds between; the other is suitcase marches, waiter walks, farmer carries and single-leg holds with a weight off to one side. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Loaded single leg / carries & offset holds
